meta.name: send
meta.description: 231 (plan stage A, A7c; DECISIONS 231): the rules of the send capability (jav/app/sending.py). The real send through Outlook reaches only the recipients listed here: an address, or '@domain' for a whole domain. Empty: nothing goes out by the real send; the output folder and the Outlook draft are not limited by it. Only an owner's decision adds a recipient.

changelog.note: 231 (A7c): the first version; the real send's allowlist is empty.
